visualize_anatomy.title: Read the platform's anatomy
visualize_anatomy.description: Read composed anatomy with coverage and filtered node counts. No entity data or secret values.

group.description: one anatomy group; omitted means every group

search.description: plain-text anatomy search, not a graph query

id.description: one exact anatomy part id, not a stored entity id

limit.description: maximum nodes shown; selection reports total, matching and shown counts with a truncation flag

url.description: HTTP(S) origin to observe; omitted uses this host

visualize_activity.title: Capture causal platform activity
visualize_activity.description: Capture bounded process-local causal activity with coverage and omitted counts. Recording is subscriber-only.

limit.description: maximum retained activity events, including start and end events

wait.description: milliseconds to keep this capture subscribed; zero reads only available history

url.description: HTTP(S) origin to observe; omitted uses this host
